cb37fe8e28: Only to answer you and, if you want am, to send you weather alerts for your farm. You dey ask for am when you write FarmPartner, and you fit stop anytime.
b0c7e1fa92: You fit ask to see, correct, download or delete your data, or object to how we dey use am. Write us and we go reply inside one month. You fit also complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency (aepd.es).
